title: Filtration of a constructible sheaf by extensions by zero of lisse sheaves
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$, and $F\in\Cons(X,\Lambda)$. Let
$S_1,\dots,S_m$ be a stratification adapted to $F$, ordered as in
[det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification] (1), so that $V_k=S_1\cup\dots\cup S_k$ is
open, with open immersions $v_k\colon V_k\hookrightarrow X$, and let $a_k\colon S_k\hookrightarrow X$.
Put $F_k=v_{k!}v_k^*F\subseteq F$. Then
$$
0=F_0\subseteq F_1\subseteq\dots\subseteq F_m=F,\qquad F_k/F_{k-1}\cong a_{k!}(F|_{S_k}),
$$
and each $F|_{S_k}$ is lisse.
Here $V_0=\varnothing$, and lisse means locally free of finite rank for the pro-étale topology. The category $\Cons(X,\Lambda)$ is the category of constructible $\Lambda_X$-modules of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. For a locally closed immersion $a\colon S\hookrightarrow X$, write $a=i\circ u$, where $u\colon S\hookrightarrow\overline S$ is open and $i\colon\overline S\hookrightarrow X$ is closed, and define $a_!=i_*u_!$. The inclusions in the filtration need not be strict.

proof.text:
Use the canonical coefficient isomorphisms of [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients] (1) throughout: inverse-image coefficient rings are the specified $\Lambda_T$, and module pullback is exact inverse image. Every open subscheme of $X$ is Noetherian, hence quasi-compact, by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian], and is quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated]. Every open immersion between such schemes is quasi-compact: its preimage over an affine open is again an open subscheme of a Noetherian scheme. Thus [det-sf-open-closed-sequence-ring-sheaf] applies on $X$ and every $V_k$. Its clause (3) makes the counit $F_k=v_{k!}v_k^*F\to F$ a monomorphism. For $w:V_{k-1}\hookrightarrow V_k$, clause (1) and the pure-open composition isomorphism of [lem-sfb-locally-closed-extension-coherence] give
$$F_{k-1}\simeq v_{k!}w_!w^*v_k^*F\longrightarrow v_{k!}v_k^*F=F_k\longrightarrow F.$$
This composite is the counit for $v_{k-1}$: under its open adjunction, both it and that counit restrict to the identity on $v_{k-1}^*F$. Here the composition comparison restricts to the identity by the normalization in the cited coherence statement. Hence these are inclusions of subsheaves over $F$. Extension from the empty open is zero (the left adjoint from the zero module category), and extension along the identity is the identity. Therefore $F_0=0$ and $F_m=F$.

source.place: First paragraph: coefficient identifications, counit subobjects, nested opens and endpoints.

proof.text:
Fix $1\leq k\leq m$, put $G=v_k^*F$, and let $c:S_k\hookrightarrow V_k$ be the closed complement of $w:V_{k-1}\hookrightarrow V_k$. Clause (3) of [det-sf-open-closed-sequence-ring-sheaf] gives
$$0\to w_!w^*G\to G\to c_*c^*G\to0.$$
Apply the exact functor $v_{k!}$ from clause (1). Using the composition and counit identifications established in step 1 and $c^*G=F|_{S_k}$, obtain
$$0\to F_{k-1}\to F_k\to v_{k!}c_*(F|_{S_k})\to0.$$
The first map is the inclusion over $F$ from step 1, so its cokernel is precisely the subsheaf quotient $F_k/F_{k-1}$. All qcqs and quasi-compact-open hypotheses are those checked in step 1.

source.place: Second paragraph: localization on V_k and exact open extension.

proof.text:
The immersion $a_k:S_k\hookrightarrow X$ has the closed-then-open factorization $a_k=v_k\circ c$ and the open-then-closed factorization $a_k=i\circ u$ through its closure, as in the statement. Apply [lem-sfb-locally-closed-extension-coherence] with $R=\Lambda_X$. It gives, on module sheaves, the canonical factorization comparison
$$v_{k!}c_*\simeq i_*u_!=a_{k!}.$$
Its hypotheses are exactly that $X$ is Noetherian and $R$ is a commutative ring sheaf; it is not restricted to finite constant coefficients. The inverse-image rings are identified with $\Lambda_{S_k}$ and the other prescribed coefficients by step 1. Substituting this comparison into step 2 yields $F_k/F_{k-1}\simeq a_{k!}(F|_{S_k})$. This invokes the existing general comparison theorem rather than identifying sheaves merely from their restrictions.

source.place: Second paragraph: the asserted equality v_k! c_* = a_k!, made precise by the existing factorization-comparison theorem.

proof.text: By the adapted-stratification hypothesis and the constructible/lisse characterization in [det-lem-coefficient-heart-closure], each $F|_{S_k}$ is lisse. The filtration terms are constructible too. Indeed clause (1) of [det-sf-open-closed-sequence-ring-sheaf] gives $v_k^*F_k\simeq v_k^*F$, so their restrictions to earlier strata are those of $F$. Let $z:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be the closed complement of $v_k$. In clause (3) applied to $M=v_{k!}N$, the counit $v_{k!}v_k^*v_{k!}N\to v_{k!}N$ is an isomorphism: its inverse is $v_{k!}$ of the unit, by clause (1) and the triangle identity. Thus $z_*z^*v_{k!}N=0$, and applying $z^*$ and clause (2) gives $z^*v_{k!}N=0$. Every later stratum factors through $Z$ as a locally closed subscheme, so $F_k$ restricts to zero there. Hence $F_k$ is lisse on each stratum (zero has rank zero), and the cited characterization proves constructibility. The inclusions may be equal, for example when $F=0$; no strictness is claimed.

source.place: Last sentence: lisseness on the adapted strata; verification that the filtration belongs to Cons.

proof_origin.place: First and second proof paragraphs, using the existing arbitrary-ring localization and locally closed factorization-comparison statements.

The statement is byte-identical to the unsplit base. Its non-strict inclusions are correct: F=0 makes the blueprint's strict inclusions false. There are no new nodes. proof_deps equals the union of the step uses. Step lengths are 1395/622/819/965 characters, so the previous 2111-character step 3 is gone. The cited nodes' statement and proof dependencies do not lead back to the item, so there is no cycle. Hypotheses: the Noetherian leaves make V_k qcqs and V_{k-1}->V_k quasi-compact, which is what det-sf-open-closed-sequence-ring-sheaf needs, for any ring sheaf B. lem-sfb-locally-closed-extension-coherence needs X Noetherian and R commutative; Lambda_X is commutative, and its v_! is the left adjoint, so it agrees with the localization j_!. sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients (1) covers E and Qlb without needing ell invertible. Step 1: the counit is mono by clause (3). The nesting map v_{k!}w_!w^*v_k^*F -> v_{k!}v_k^*F -> F and the counit of v_{k-1} have the same adjunct because gamma restricts to the identity on V_{k-1}, so F_{k-1} is a subsheaf of F_k. F_0=0 and F_m=F. Step 2: S_k -> V_k is a closed immersion (an immersion with closed image). Applying the exact v_{k!} to the localization sequence makes the cokernel the actual quotient F_k/F_{k-1}. Step 3: the normalized comparison v_{k!}c_* = i_*u_! replaces the blueprint's loose argument that the two extensions have the same restrictions. Step 4: F|_{S_k} is lisse by the constructibility characterization in det-lem-coefficient-heart-closure. Its extra constructibility argument for F_k is correct but needs a scheme structure on Z, a minor point beyond what the statement claims. Edge cases checked: X empty, F=0, m=1, k=1, non-reduced strata. The route follows unit step (3) and the blueprint proof with no departure.
